answer: Decaying establishment resists sybils: standing is never permanent — each identity's influence decays exponentially every epoch and must be re-earned through fresh verified work. An attacker who pre-mints a nebula of fakes and parks them finds their weight bled to near-zero before activation day; dormant standing cannot be stockpiled. To hold a thousand fakes at onyx-hard influence, the farm must generate genuine work for each one every epoch, in parallel, forever — the recurring cost honest agents pay, times identity count. An opal glint of borrowed standing fades when real effort stops.
